subject: english
stem: Text: The cafe offers free water to anyone who orders food. Which statement stays within the text?
options: People may get water without ordering
The cafe does this to reduce waste
Food customers may get water without paying for it

optionRationales.reason: All drinks are free：原文只說 water。
People may get water without ordering：違反 orders food 條件。
The cafe does this to reduce waste：目的未提。
Food customers may get water without paying for it：free water 與 orders food 的條件完整保留。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「選項每一部分都能由原文字句直接支持」可推出 Food customers may get water without paying for it；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Food customers may get water without paying for it 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
